meta_description:
1,334 likes, 15 comments - the_unconventional_ca on August 13, 2026: "What actually goes into a pre-seed pitch deck?

Aditya Singh (All In Capital) broke it down to four slides:

01 — Team
02 — Product
03 — Problem in the market
04 — Your solution

And one rule most founders break: no more than 5 words on a slide. The investor came to listen, not to read.

Founders, save this one.

Full episode on YouTube — link in bio.

Keywords: pitch deck, pre seed funding, startup funding India, venture capital, how to pitch to investors, seed round, angel investment, fundraising, founder advice, VC funding, Indian startups, first time founder, investor pitch, startup tips, deck structure

#pitchdeck #startupfunding #venturecapital #founders #startupindia".
